label: WATCH

evidence_objects_collection.scope: accepted evidence objects for TAIL in the declared corpus
evidence_objects_collection.ordering: available_as_of DESC, accession_number DESC, source_hash DESC
evidence_objects_collection.note: PREVIEW: a capped newest-first slice; total_available counts objects in scope; an as-of query over this slice is INCOMPLETE unless returned == total_available

as_of_recipe: Load /why/{TICKER}.json for history_url and history_manifest_url. Use ONLY the COMPLETE history file whose build_id, SHA-256, byte count and object count match the manifest. Filter available_as_of <= D after normalizing timestamps to UTC; a date-only D means 23:59:59.999999 UTC. Do not substitute filing_date or generated. A capped PREVIEW returns INCOMPLETE unless returned equals total_available; it cannot establish zero historical evidence. D outside corpus_start/corpus_end returns OUT_OF_RANGE. Classification at D uses the label_history entry with the maximum eligible date, not list order. Before that ribbon, use yuclaw replay TICKER --date D on a research backend.
verify: source_hash identifies the original stored event record; it is not a digest of the displayed excerpt or the original SEC file. Public event inclusion verification: NOT_AVAILABLE. /evidence/verify.json describes SIGNAL snapshot ledger checks and does not authenticate this event hash. Quote occurrence, semantic support, arithmetic and external provenance are separate checks.
not_advice: Research and education only — not investment advice. Signal labels are research classifications, not buy/sell recommendations. Investment implication: none established — no buy, sell, or alpha conclusion is supported by this object.

descriptive_denominators_90d.note: Multiple events can come from one filing. Counts describe this corpus; neither events nor filings are independent observations by assumption.

component_anatomy.reason: This historical public snapshot does not expose stored per-component confidences or historical weights; they have not been reconstructed or assumed.
